verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents job APIs that let you trigger runs, monitor status, download results and inspect failed files. Its Transform quickstarts are framed around creating jobs, and workflows can be run via SDK/REST, so asynchronous jobs with status polling are supported. Nothing in the evidence mentions completion webhooks or callbacks, so the story's non-blocking notification half is unevidenced. Missing for 10: completion webhooks/callback notifications, explicit async semantics and polling details for long parses, independent or hands-on corroboration.
